title: Grateful Dead Live at Eureka Municipal Auditorium on 1968-01-20

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a rare, jazzy 1968 set featuring the first Clementine, Spanish Jam and stellar Pigpen keyboards.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this pre‑1970 performance – a brief but sweet show packed with rarities like the debut of "Clementine," a superb "Spanish Jam" segueing into "Caution," and tight, Coltrane‑inspired swings that even earn Benny Goodman comparisons. The Miller soundboard source is described as crystal‑clear, letting every instrument – especially Pigpen’s keyboards and Jerry’s spacious New Potato – shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Four out of five reviews give 5‑star praise for both performance and audio quality; only one low rating mentions missing track info, not the music itself.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller source praised as the best available; reviewers note crystal‑clear mix where every instrument is audible and no major dropouts or muffling reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Brief but cohesive set with exceptionally smooth, jazzy transitions; the swing feel is highlighted throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Delivers spacious New Potato sound and leads vocal on "Clementine"; praised for guitar tone.
band_member_comments.Phil: His composition "Clementine" showcased; noted influence from Coltrane, adding to the jazzy vibe.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen on keyboards is described as being at his best, showing serious chops.
